cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. What do you gain if your cousin wins the club election? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And which of your proposals becomes easier to approve?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I know which square of competence we're discussing.
